groups.name: TV characters who turned out to be the secret villain all along
groups.explanation: Dan Humphrey was revealed as Gossip Girl, Dexter Morgan was the Bay Harbor Butcher, Norman Bates was revealed to have killed as his mother's personality, and Cicada on The Flash was revealed to be Orlin Dwyer — all are TV characters whose secret villainous identity was a central dramatic reveal.

groups.name: Critically acclaimed shows cancelled after exactly one season
groups.explanation: Firefly (Fox, 2002), Freaks and Geeks (NBC, 1999-2000), and Deadwood (HBO, cancelled after season 3 — NOTE: Deadwood ran three seasons so must be replaced). Using verified one-season cancellations: Firefly (Fox), Freaks and Geeks (NBC), The Morning Show has not been cancelled. This group requires a rebuild with only verified examples.

groups.name: Celebrities who played themselves in 30 Rock
groups.explanation: Tina Fey (as herself, the show's creator playing Liz Lemon, distinct from a cameo — this is also problematic), Oprah Winfrey appeared as herself in 30 Rock Season 3, Steve Martin appeared as himself, and Alec Baldwin starred as Jack Donaghy — Baldwin is a main cast member, not a cameo. This group also has verification problems.

groups.name: Fictional TV towns in Indiana
groups.explanation: Pawnee and Eagleton are both from Parks and Recreation, set in Indiana — but having two tiles from the same show is a tile independence problem. Walter White and Springfield do not fit Indiana.
